acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira and producer Robyn Semien go behind the scenes with some of the Obama staffers to hear what it felt like in the days leading up to the infamous Beer Summit of 2009.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Maybe the most radical national experiment to avoid tribalism ever done, anywhere in the world. Of course the key moment two sides come together happens in a bar.
acts.title: One More For My Baby and One More For the Road

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: A Democratic club at a bar in South Bend, Indiana, melts down over President Trump, and producer Ben Calhoun is there to see who’s still left in the club at the end of the night.
acts.title: Lagerheads
